headline: Stop the gain cycle today, start losing weight
summary: You gained 1.8 kg last month; today you reverse that by eating only Huel-portioned meals and doing 45 minutes rowing to establish the discipline needed to hit -0.87 kg/week.
details: Today: eat only Huel meals and vegetables; avoid all discretionary snacking by planning your eating before hunger strikes—you have 285 days to lose 35.5 kg, and every day of gain costs you progress. Row or run hard for 45 minutes this afternoon to burn ~2,000 kJ and prove to yourself this turnaround starts now. Today matters because it's Tuesday—you're early in the week with momentum available, and you need to anchor discipline before Friday's emotional snacking hits; make today the pivot point.
